class Channel:
    cap: int
    items: list[int]

def new_channel(cap: int) -> Channel:
    """Empty channel that holds at most cap integers."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out.items.len() == 0 and out.cap == cap
    ex new_channel(3).cap == 3
    return Channel(cap=cap, items=[])

def try_send(var ch: Channel, v: int) -> bool:
    """Append v if the channel has room and report True; otherwise leave it unchanged and report False. Never blocks."""
    post ch.items.len() <= ch.cap
    if ch.items.len() < ch.cap:
        ch.items.append(v)
        return True
    return False

def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Create a channel of capacity cap, try to send each element of xs without blocking, and stop at the first rejected send. Return how many sends were accepted."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0 and out <= cap and out <= xs.len()
    ch = new_channel(cap)
    n = 0
    for x in xs:
        if not try_send(&ch, x):
            break
        n += 1
    return n
